column1: # Missable content for missable-content warnings: NPC questline steps, missable items and
# ending requirements. Derived from the game's own files: NPC questline states and the
# conditions that move them come from the event scripts, what is said at each step from the talk scripts
# (lines through TalkParam), items from ItemLotParam. Event-script instruction meanings: DarkScript3's DS3
# instruction table, used for facts only (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). All text below is our own.
# Flags: 8-digit event flags (boss kills from data/bosses.tsv, talk flags set by the talk scripts, pickup
# flags from ItemLotParam +0x80); 4-digit flags are global flags: NPC questline states (one flag per step
# of an NPC, set by the event scripts; e.g. 1137 = Sirris gone) and 9482 (Cuculus lived through the Old
# Demon King fight).
# Columns: id <TAB> kind (npc / item / ending) <TAB> topic <TAB> area <TAB> relevant <TAB> trigger <TAB> done
#          <TAB> short <TAB> do <TAB> lose
#   relevant / trigger / done use the route.tsv condition syntax (space-separated groups, all must hold; '|'
#   between alternatives; a flag or "Nof:flag,..."); "-" = always (relevant) or unknown (trigger, done).
#   relevant: when the warning starts to apply; for NPC steps, that step or any later step of the NPC, so the
#             entry stays to show done or missed.   trigger: when it's too late (the lockout).
#   done: when the game itself shows it's handled. Otherwise the player marks it done on the live page.
#   area: where the action happens (the overlay alerts there).   short: one line for the overlay.
# Siegward: his Yhorm step (state 1388) needs all four talk flags below and Yhorm alive; Yhorm dying first
# gives the other end of his questline (1390).
siegward-settlement
